credit: New asset for the Paper port: a single straight segment of the gas pump's hose. The original mod draws the bent hose as a procedural quad strip in Java (see GasPumpRenderer#drawHose); vanilla clients have no equivalent hook, so the Paper plugin instead chains several of these thin segments together with vanilla display entities and bends the chain through the exact same Hermite-spline math the original renderer used (see HermiteSpline). Native length is one full block along local Z, starting exactly at the model's own origin (not its center) so a segment's entity position can be its spline start point directly; the X/Z cross-section is centered on that same origin (not at the block's center, i.e. not [7.5,8.5]) so rotating/stretching the segment pivots cleanly around its own centerline instead of swinging around a point half a block off to the side.
